text:
sara: kicking off the Launchpad NA-1 validation thread. attaching the lightweight smoke checklist for the new region cluster. want quick eyes on SLO gates and any networking gotchas before handoff.

eli: thanks — pasted checklist below. did a dry run of the kube-probe targets earlier, one node had kubelet flapping but recovered. will re-run health after infra patch.

ben: quick note on capacity: initial GPU pool requested 48xA100-40G. can we start with 32 and reserve burst 16 to control cost during ramp? also need to confirm spot fallback policy.

maria: tagging cost team for guidance: @maria FYI on reserved vs spot ratio. we should set autoscale min=8, target=32, max=64 for first 72h.

kmurthy: ops-runbook-bot added the checklist template: 

ops-runbook-bot: CHECKLIST v0.3 (auto-generated)
- infra: VPC/subnets created, route tables verified
- networking: egress NAT, firewall rules, peering to prod-svc VPCs
- control plane: api-server reachable from console IPs
- nodes: kubelet ready >= 95% across pool
- GPUs: drivers + CUDA compatibility verified on sample node
- runtime: model-serving image pulls + warmup logs OK
- perf: p50 < 80ms token gen, p95 < 300ms (local tests)
- cost guardrails: spot fallback configured, quota alerts set
- handoff: oncall playbook + escalation POC

eli: adding commands I ran for health checks (shareable):
```
# list nodes + GPU health
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe node gpu-node-27 | egrep -i "gpu|nvidia|taint|condition"
# sample pod startup logs
kubectl -n inference logs -f model-warmup-0 --tail=200
```

maria: for SLOs we want explicit gates before we flip traffic:
- infra-stable: node reboot rate < 0.5% / 1h
- kube-ready: nodes Ready >= 99% over 15m window
- model-latency: p95 generation <= 350ms with 1-2 token priming
- cold-start: median cold-start <= 2.5s for small models

tony: networking gotcha: NA-1 NAT gateway egress IP pools are smaller than other regions. if we plan to run mass model downloads (500+ images) during bootstrap, we'll hit ephemeral port exhaustion. recommendation: stagger downloads, add a second NAT GW, or use S3 VPC endpoints.

ben: noted on image pulls. we'll enable S3 VPC endpoint and add a second NAT for the first 48 hours.

eli: during earlier run I saw one node with driver mismatch: nvidia-driver 525 vs expected 530. quick remediation: cordon + drain node, upgrade driver, uncordon. putting a remediation playbook step in the checklist.

sara: add step: verify CUDA version with sample container before allowing traffic: `docker run --gpus all nvidia/cuda:11.8-base nvidia-smi`

kmurthy: logging & tracing checks: ensure fluentd forwarder is receiving logs from runtime pods and traces are visible in the trace UI for model-init. quick query: `trace:service:model-serving AND http.request.duration > 100ms` — should show warmup invocations.

deploy-bot: automated smoke run scheduled: start=1767001400 id=launchpad-na1-smoke-2025-07-14
deploy-bot: step1: image-pull test -> PASSED
deploy-bot: step2: pod startup 3 replicas -> PASSED
deploy-bot: step3: sample inference p50=62ms p95=210ms -> PASSED
deploy-bot: step4: GPU utilization ramp -> WARN (one node at 98% during kernel warmup)

eli: follow-up on WARN: that was transient during kernel module initialization. mitigated by staggered pod starts. adding `startupDelaySeconds: 15` to the DaemonSet that preloads CUDA libs.

maria: cost note: if kernel warmup keeps hitting high util we should throttle concurrency per GPU to avoid thermal throttling and increased power draw. set soft concurrency limit to 10 pods per A100-40G for now.

tony: security check: ensure ingress only from Redwood console CIDR and restricted access to kube-api. also confirm KMS permissions for private key material used by private deployments.

ben: who owns the handoff doc to oncall? I can prepare a short playbook but need a co-author for escalation contacts.

eli: I'll draft playbook. include quick-links: dashboard (perf URLs), pod lists, common remediation commands, hotspot logs, and exact rollback steps for model runtime image.

sara: pre-handoff gate: 1) deploy-bot smoke must be all PASS or WARN-only with documented mitigation; 2) SLOs measured for 30m under synthetic load; 3) networking egress test (1000 connections) without port exhaustion; 4) cost guardrails in place.

kmurthy: running synthetic load now, will push metrics to dashboards. ETA 15m.

deploy-bot: synthetic load results uploaded -> link: https://dashboards.redwood/na1/launchpad/synthetic-1767001234
deploy-bot: metrics snapshot: p50=70ms p95=275ms error-rate=0.3% (target <1%)

eli: test logs show one transient kube-sched spike at 1767001600, caused by kube-controller restarting due to an etcd snapshot rotation. fixed by bumping controller restart limits. adding to postmortem notes.

maria: with those results i'm comfortable with handoff assuming the NAT scaling plan is implemented and driver mismatches are resolved.

sara: ok final action items before handoff:
- ben: enact NAT scaling + S3 endpoint (done)
- eli: driver remediation playbook + startupDelaySeconds change (in PR)
- kmurthy: dashboard short window + tracing links (in progress)
- ben/maria: set spot fallback to 20% and alerts on unexpected preemptions (pending)

ben: I set the spot fallback flag to 20% and created alert rule: `gpu.pool.preemptions > 5 in 5m` -> pager.

eli: PR merged for startupDelay and driver check script at `infra/na1/driver-fix.sh`.

ops-runbook-bot: Handoff checklist complete -> oncall assigned: @tony for 24h primary, @eli backup. playbook URL: https://confluence.redwood/na1-handoff-1767001234

tony: taking primary. will do first 2hr watch and escalate if p95 > 400ms or node reboots > 1/hr. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sara: excellent. closing this thread after doc link is uploaded. please add any follow-ups as replies to the confluence page.

ben: added a short cost estimate for first week to the page (~$18k/day at peak), will refine tomorrow.

eli: noted. leaving a short checklist item to run a 'cold-start storm' test at 02:00 UTC to validate cold-start SLOs under traffic shape.

sara: thanks everyone — handoff live.
